responseComponents.text: Answers the claim that differing Passion portrayals defeat historical knowledge by applying standard historical criteria to identify an essential and sufficient core of Jesus's activities.

additions.proposition: Multiple historical criteria support an essential and sufficient core of Jesus's major activities, permitting recovery of the principal contours of his public life.
additions.inventoryRationale: This is Evans's principal answer to the activities question and directly counters Ehrman's claim that narrative differences defeat historical knowledge.
